The load-bearing steps behind 'constructs a reference Hadamard state' and 'for any Hadamard state' are written-only, not machine-replayed: the wavefront-set claim ('Its Hadamard wavefront set is preserved by the smooth nonvanishing factors and the conformal light cones'), positivity of the rescaled bisolution, the positive-frequency restriction ('discarding the nonnegative target-state term'), and the C_c^infinity-to-H2_0 density extension. Neither residuals block (fixed_background_and_field_map.residuals covers KG/Wronskian/coordinate identities; difference_QSEI_derivation.residuals covers IBP/spectral/positive-square identities) checks these. This is permitted at CERTIFIED under this ledger's schema-1 boundary disclosure (status + not_established + written_proof + named notes file), which this certificate uses in place of a verification_boundary field; recorded so the receipt shows exactly where the machine boundary lies. Two compressions in the statement resolve only via the certificate, though consistently: (1) the statement gives Q's integrand but never the inequality direction; the actual bound 'integral h^2*(E_omega-E_reference) dt >= -Q[h]' exists only in difference_QSEI_derivation.bound; (2) 'the exact field map chi=a*phi constructs a reference Hadamard state' compresses the actual construction, which is the conformally rescaled Minkowski vacuum W0_Mink/[a(eta)*a(eta')] (fixed_background_and_field_map.reference_two_point) — the field map alone constructs no state. No contradiction found between statement, certificate, derivation.md, and FORMULATION.md on any checked item, including the 111/256 credit vs the all-duration threshold -111*hbar/(4096*pi^2*t^4) (equal to beta=111/256 in the statement's 16*pi^2 normalization).
